jobs.title: Business Relationship Manager - Nassau South, Assistant Vice President
jobs.location: Franklin Square, New York, United States
jobs.description:
The Business Banker is responsible for proactively sourcing, acquiring, expanding, and retaining customer relationships by maximizing sales opportunities in an assigned Area, growing and retaining a book of business , and ensuring a world-class customer experience for all current and prospective clients. Individuals in this role are Subject Matter Experts (SME) on Deposit, Credit, and Cash Management products and support their assigned area branches end to end.

Responsibilities :
- Lead as the subject matter expert across a broad sales Area of assigned branches, which comprise of branch stakeholders and other Area partners (e.g. Wealth Management, Mortgage)
- Partner with cross retail segment Area peers spanning Wealth Management, Consumer and Mortgage and initiate collaboration to optimize relationships to execute sales plan
- Accountable to scorecard metrics and KPI’s as defined by Senior Management
- Support the development of small business knowledge and skills to assigned branch Area team through execution of joint sales activities, ongoing training, and identifying referral opportunities
- Call on your assigned book of high valued clients, to deepen the relationship and retain their business, while owning, responding to, and proactively uncovering future needs, roadblocks, or risks for the business to achieve their goals
- Educate and introduce clients to the appropriate products and services that fit their needs and grow both the balance and revenue of your portfolio
- Manage credit requests up to $250K, and work closely with Sr. Business Bankers on lending relationships over $250K
- Develop and execute an integrated and comprehensive sales plan to achieve scorecard results, drive acquisition of new to bank clients and target industry/sectors maximizing the highest potential across designated territory
- Adhere to sales management routines, sales practices and protocols for Business Banking to ensure compliance with all policies and procedures.
- Proactively manage portfolio of assigned high value clients. Expand business banking customer relationships by identifying needs and maximizing opportunities while ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.
- Foster teamwork and Business Banking knowledge in all assigned branches to ensure a positive customer experience. Be accountable to client service scores.

- Collaborate with Consumer and Wealth business partners to deepen client relationships.
- Work closely with the credit/risk team and Branches to facilitate loan closings, including pipeline management, loan escalations / appeals and advocacy, application quality and pricing issues.
- Strictly adhere to internal control policies such as the account opening and credit protocols of accurate collection, completion and updating of all required documentation.
- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:
- 5-8 years of experience, preferably 2-5 years banking experience or 2-3 years in Business Banking
- Exceptional consulting skills; ability to probe, listen, clarify and present information to advance sales transactions, deepen relationships
- Demonstrate analytical skills and ability to assimilate complex financial and company operating information
- Professional presentation skills
- Strong working knowledge of credit structuring and processing; credit trained preferred
- Highly effective communication and influence skills
- Customer oriented and responsive
- Superior organizational skills
- Excellent business development skills
- This position requires the employee to register as a mortgage loan originator with the Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry ("Registry") and obtain a unique identifier from the Registry before engaging in mortgage loan originator activities, to maintain and renew that registration on an annual basis, to update registration information with the Registry on a timely basis, and to provide that unique identifier to consumers as required by applicable SAFE Act regulations and Citi policies and procedures

Education:
- Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience

The Business Banker is responsible for proactively sourcing, acquiring, expanding, and retaining customer relationships by maximizing sales opportunities in an assigned Area, growing and retaining a book of business , and ensuring a world-class customer experience for all current and prospective clients. Individuals in this role are Subject Matter Experts (SME) on Deposit, Credit, and Cash Management products and support their assigned area branches end to end.

- Lead as the subject matter expert across a broad sales Area of assigned branches, which comprise of branch stakeholders and other Area partners (e.g. Wealth Management, Mortgage)

- Call on your assigned book of high valued clients, to deepen the relationship and retain their business, while owning, responding to, and proactively uncovering future needs, roadblocks, or risks for the business to achieve their goals
- Educate and introduce clients to the appropriate products and services that fit their needs and grow both the balance and revenue of your portfolio
- Manage credit requests up to $250K, and work closely with Sr. Business Bankers on lending relationships over $250K
- Develop and execute an integrated and comprehensive sales plan to achieve scorecard results, drive acquisition of new to bank clients and target industry/sectors maximizing the highest potential across designated territory

jobs.title: Commercial Banking: POG Group Manager - Senior Vice President
jobs.description:
Summary of Role - Head of Portfolio Optimization Group, India Citi Commercial Bank
The Head of Portfolio Optimization Group (POG) for India Citi Commercial Bank (CCB) manages a team of POG Relationship Managers and is responsible for the end-to-end oversight of the assigned de-marketing portfolio within the country.  This includes supervising workload allocation, reviewing case quality, clearing blockers, and ensuring that each client progresses through assessment, de-risking, and exit processes in accordance with Citi's policies, controls, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.  The role provides centralized coordination for escalations, partners with Operations, Compliance, Risk, and Product teams to expedite execution, and keeps the Country CCB Head and Clusters POG Head informed on progress, risks, and key issues. The Team Lead is accountable for accurate reporting, timely dashboard updates, and portfolio-level visibility for regional and global stakeholders.  This position requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, execution discipline, and the ability to drive consistent, high-quality outcomes across the team.

Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Oversight
- Lead, manage, and support a team of POG Relationship Managers responsible for de-marketing and portfolio management activities.
- Perform and oversee day-to-day case execution, ensuring all POG RMs follow consistent standards, documentation requirements, and communication protocols.
- Review team output for quality, accuracy, and completeness, providing coaching where required to strengthen delivery and judgment.
- Monitor team workload and progress, reallocating resources as necessary to meet deadlines and maintain balanced capacity.
- Serve as the primary country-level escalation point for complex or sensitive POG client situations.

Portfolio Management & Execution
- Maintain end-to-end oversight of the assigned portfolio within the country, ensuring timely assessments, risk evaluations, and de-marketing actions.
- Partner with Operations, Compliance, and cross-functional teams to expedite client transitions, exits, and remediation activities.
- Track portfolio milestones, workflows, and bottlenecks to ensure smooth execution and proactive problem solving.
- Ensure all regulatory, KYC, AML, and policy-driven obligations are met across the team's portfolio.

Escalation & Stakeholder Engagement
- Manage escalations in coordination with Compliance, Legal, Product, Risk, and Operations partners.
- Keep the Country CCB Head and Clusters POG Head informed of material issues, portfolio risks, delays, and decisions requiring senior management intervention.
- Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders to align priorities, clarify expectations, and remove execution barriers.

Reporting, Transparency & Controls
- Oversee the accuracy and timeliness of all dashboards, trackers, and reporting submitted by POG Relationship Managers.
- Consolidate portfolio-level reporting for regional and global stakeholders, ensuring full visibility of progress, timelines, risks, and outstanding actions.
- Ensure strict adherence to Citi policies, control requirements, regulatory obligations, and documentation standards.
- Appropriately assess risk when making decisions, demonstrating sound judgment, effective escalation, and transparency.

jobs.description:
Relationship Manager, Core Coverage - Vice President
Shape the Next Generation of Australian Growth Companies

This is a unique opportunity to lead Citi Commercial Bank (CCB) Australia's coverage of businesses turning over $15 - $150 million, a strategically important segment focused on acquiring, banking and growing relationships with some of Australia's most dynamic and rapidly scaling companies.

Reporting directly to the Country Head of Citi Commercial Bank Australia and serving as a member of Citi Commercial Bank Australia’s Leadership Team, the successful candidate will play a critical role in shaping the future direction of the franchise. The role offers exceptional exposure to senior leadership across Citi, direct influence on business strategy, and the opportunity to build long-term relationships with high-growth companies as they evolve from domestic market leaders into global enterprises.

You will work with public and private corporates at pivotal stages of growth, helping them navigate expansion, acquisitions, internationalisation, capital raising and broader strategic opportunities. Leveraging Citi's global network and institutional capabilities, you will originate, develop and deepen client relationships by delivering comprehensive banking solutions across transaction banking, trade finance, lending and financial markets, partnering with clients throughout their lifecycle and becoming a trusted advisor to executive leadership teams.

This role is ideally suited to an ambitious banker looking to accelerate their career, broaden their leadership experience, deepen their client coverage capabilities and build a reputation as a leading relationship manager within one of the world's premier financial institutions.

Key Responsibilities
Leadership & Franchise Development
- Lead Citi Commercial Bank Australia's Core Coverage segment and contribute to the strategic direction of the broader Australian franchise.
- Serve as a member of the Australian CCB Leadership Team, helping shape business priorities, client strategy and growth initiatives.
- Drive origination efforts focused on identifying, targeting and acquiring new-to-bank relationships across Australia's high-growth mid-market segment.
- Build and execute sector and client acquisition strategies aligned with Citi's growth objectives.

Client Coverage & Relationship Management
- Manage a significant portfolio of client relationships and serve as the primary point of contact for senior executives and key decision makers.
- Develop trusted advisory relationships with founders, CEOs, CFOs and private equity sponsors.
- Anticipate client needs and proactively identify opportunities to support clients through key growth milestones.
- Deepen existing relationships and increase share of wallet through coordinated delivery of Citi's capabilities.

Business Development & Growth
- Source, develop and convert new business opportunities across lending, treasury and trade solutions, capital markets, foreign exchange and broader institutional banking products.
- Identify rapidly scaling companies that would benefit from Citi's global network, international footprint and product expertise.
- Partner with product specialists, investment banking, markets and transaction banking teams to deliver holistic client solutions.
- Build and maintain a strong external network across the Australian corporate, investor, advisory and private equity ecosystem.

Credit & Risk Management
- Own and oversee the end-to-end credit relationship for assigned clients.
- Structure and negotiate complex financing solutions while maintaining disciplined risk management standards.
- Ensure appropriate identification, escalation and management of risks.
- Maintain the highest standards of compliance with Citi policies, regulatory requirements and risk governance frameworks.

Client Experience & Execution
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver a seamless and differentiated client experience.
- Support onboarding, KYC and ongoing client maintenance processes.
- Execute strategic initiatives and contribute to continuous improvement across the business.
- Share market insights, industry trends and strategic perspectives with clients to strengthen relationships and enhance Citi's value proposition.

Qualifications
- 8-15+ years of relationship management, corporate banking and commercial banking experience.
- Demonstrated success in originating, acquiring and growing corporate relationships.
- Strong credit, structuring and risk management capabilities.
- Experience working with growth companies, mid-market corporates, founder-led businesses and/or private equity-backed companies.
- Strong commercial judgment and the ability to identify and execute complex client opportunities.
- Proven leadership capability with experience influencing stakeholders across multiple functions.
- Exceptional interpersonal, communication and relationship management skills.
- Ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
- Strong strategic thinking, business development and execution skills.
- Passion for client acquisition, franchise building and helping companies achieve their growth ambitions.
- Experience working across multiple banking products and solutions is highly desirable.

What This Role Offers
- Direct reporting line to the Country Head of Citi Commercial Bank Australia.
- Membership of the Australian CCB Leadership Team.

- Significant client-facing autonomy and responsibility.
- Exposure to senior executives, founders, private equity sponsors and board-level stakeholders.

jobs.title: Banking: IGS : Business Manager : MISG - Vice President
jobs.description:
The Banking Support Lead Analyst is a senior role within the Banking team, responsible for the expert execution of a variety of support functions to ensure team efficiency and effectiveness. The overall objective is to provide specialized, reliable, and high-quality research support to key banking transactions.

About the Team
Mumbai Information Services Group (MISG), provides essential information and research support to our banking teams across the globe. The group is a key partner to our investment bankers, helping them with research for pitching and executing major M&A and financing deals.

The Role
We are looking for an experienced leader to spearhead the evolution of our Information Services Group, advancing beyond traditional research to deliver high-impact analytical insights that drive investment banking transactions. A key component of this role will be leveraging AI to augment the team's research capabilities, enabling more sophisticated analysis and greater efficiency in supporting our banking teams globally.

Your Responsibilities
- Oversee Research & Analysis Delivery:  Direct the team in producing in-depth company and industry analysis, including business profiles, competitive landscapes, market sizing, and trend analysis to support client pitches and live transactions.
- Enhance Financial Data Analysis:  Guide the team in gathering and interpreting financial data to support valuation analysis, including comparable company analysis ("trading comps"), precedent transaction analysis ("deal comps"), and discounted cash flow (DCF) inputs.

- Drive Strategic Change:  Develop and execute a strategy to move the team's work "up the value chain." This means finding new ways for the team to provide more complex, analytical insights.
- Innovate with AI and Technology:  Spearhead the use of AI and other technologies to improve our research capabilities and re-engineer our processes for better efficiency and service.
- Collaborate Globally:  Build strong relationships with senior investment bankers and other leaders in our offices worldwide. You'll work to understand their needs and ensure your team is providing the best possible support for their deals.

What We're Looking For in a Candidate
We're seeking a leader with a unique blend of skills and experience:
- Investment Banking Knowledge:  You should have a good understanding of investment banking products and the current M&A environment.
- Process Improvement Mindset:  We need someone who can analyze our current workflows and find opportunities for process re-engineering, especially by leveraging AI tools.
- Global Team Leadership:  You have experience managing a functional team, ideally one that works across different shifts and global offices.
- Client-Focused:  A strong desire to improve the quality and impact of the services provided to our investment bankers will be a huge plus.

Qualifications:
- 10+ years of progressive experience in banking, finance, or a related field
- Strong organizational and time-management skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A strong understanding of financial markets and concepts
- Commitment to maintaining data accuracy, confidentiality, and ethical standards.

Education:
- Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience in finance, economics, business administration, or a related field.
- Master's degree preferred.

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

You’re the brain behind our work.
Citi’s Commercial Bank (“CCB”) is looking for Full-Time Analysts to join our team. Our Commercial Banking division works with businesses with annual sales ranging from $10 million to more than $3 billion. Our Commercial Banking Team works to find ways for our clients to maximize their growth while taking full advantage of Citi’s banking products. That means knowing all about our deposit and lending, as well as our cash management, trade, FX (foreign exchange) and capital markets solutions. The Full-Time Analyst Program strives to bring in the best and brightest talent and support them as they develop into the next generation of commercial banking leaders globally.

Your time here will look like this...
The Full Analyst Program starts in July 2027 and begins with in-depth training. People learn differently, so we combine formal training with complete hands-on experience to help you quickly ramp up and adapt to your role and the culture at Citi. There will be ongoing sales, credit, product, technology, and professional skills training throughout the program along with a robust junior and senior mentorship structure to help you develop professionally.
By the conclusion of the Program, you can expect to have thorough experience with and a strong understanding of:
- The CCB target market, value proposition, and client coverage model
- How bankers interact with clients and identify their needs
- The various credit product types and how these solutions best fit client needs
- The commercial loan underwriting process, including loan structuring and documentation
- The end-to-end credit process including new origination of credit and the monitoring of an assigned credit portfolio
- Engaging with clients, prospects, and centers of influence
- Citi credit and regulatory policies and procedures

We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.
We're committed to teaching you the ropes. The Analyst Program starts in July and begins with an in-depth training program. Based on your interests and our needs, you will be matched with a Commercial Banking team to work with for the duration of the Program.

Analysts play a critical role in meeting the needs of our clients and prospects, including:
- Conducting company research and industry analysis
- Analysing financial data and performing financial modelling focused on company valuations, discounted cash flow analysis, and pro-forma analyses

- Playing a role in deal management and client presentation preparation, including creating business development presentations, pitch books, prospect memos, and other client-related decks
- Interacting with partners across the firm, including product, credit risk, in-business controls, legal, marketing, operations, risk, compliance, and technology teams

- You are a dynamic individual who is passionate about partnering with stakeholders to achieve goals

- You are in your final year of an undergraduate or Master's degree in any discipline at a top academic institution.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Leveraged Finance Credit Underwriting
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Citi's Leveraged Finance Underwriting team is looking for a Senior Vice President to lead credit underwriting, risk assessment, and portfolio management across complex leveraged finance transactions for sponsor-backed and corporate clients. In this senior role, you will sit at the intersection of strategic deal execution and disciplined risk management, working closely with partners across Leveraged Finance Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Corporate Banking, Risk, and Legal. Your credit judgment and leadership will directly shape the quality and performance of Citi's leveraged lending portfolio.
Additionally, the SVP may be involved in the underwriting of venture lending deals to emerging growth pre-IPO companies at the forefront of innovation. These transactions come with significant senior-level attention and exposure.

Responsibilities
- Lead the underwriting, structuring, and approval of complex leveraged finance transactions — including leveraged buyouts, acquisition financings, recapitalizations, refinancings, and dividend transactions — as well as venture lending to pre-IPO emerging growth companies.
- Act as a senior credit advisor on each transaction, providing rigorous challenge to leverage assumptions, valuation analyses, covenant structures, and risk-adjusted return profiles to ensure sound credit outcomes.
- Direct due diligence efforts across deal teams, building a thorough understanding of clients' business models, industry positioning, capital structures, and financial performance to inform credit recommendations.
- Evaluate and stress-test financial models underpinning enterprise valuations, debt capacity assessments, and operating forecasts, ensuring conclusions are well-supported and clearly presented to senior management and approval committees.
- Oversee an active credit portfolio by proactively identifying emerging risks, tracking covenant performance, liquidity trends, and refinancing challenges, and escalating concerns where appropriate.
- Ensure all transactions and ongoing portfolio activities meet Citi's credit policies, leveraged lending guidance, and regulatory expectations, including engagement with internal and external regulators.
- Lead, mentor, and develop Analysts and Associates across New York and global partner locations, setting high standards for credit underwriting, financial analysis, and risk discipline.

Required Qualifications & Skills
- 8 or more years of experience in leveraged finance underwriting, corporate banking, credit risk management, direct lending, restructuring, investment banking, or a related institutional credit discipline.
- Demonstrated expertise in evaluating and underwriting large, complex leveraged finance and/or venture lending transactions, including sponsor-backed and corporate financings.
- Deep knowledge of leveraged buyouts, acquisition financings, syndicated loans, high-yield debt, and broader leveraged finance markets, with a track record of underwriting large and complex transactions.
- Strong independent credit judgment, with the ability to assess risk-reward tradeoffs, identify structural vulnerabilities, and influence transaction outcomes across senior stakeholders.
- Advanced financial analysis skills, including the ability to interpret financial statements, evaluate cash flow generation, assess debt capacity, and critically review management projections.
- Experience operating within a highly regulated credit environment, with familiarity across leveraged lending guidance, credit policy frameworks, and governance requirements.
- Ability to lead cross-functional deal teams and drive alignment across Banking, Capital Markets, Risk, Finance, and Legal counterparts in a fast-paced transaction environment.
- Clear and persuasive communicator, with the ability to present credit analyses and portfolio recommendations to senior leadership and credit approval committees with confidence and precision.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications
- Familiarity with portfolio stress testing methodologies and credit monitoring frameworks applied across large, diversified lending portfolios.
- Prior experience developing or enhancing end-to-end credit underwriting frameworks, risk governance standards, or internal credit policy processes at an institutional level.

What We Offer

This is a senior leadership role with genuine influence over one of Citi's most strategically significant credit franchises. You will gain exposure to a broad range of industries, financial sponsors, capital structures, and market conditions, while playing a central part in decisions that shape portfolio quality and risk-adjusted returns at scale.
- Direct ownership of high-profile, complex leveraged finance transactions with visibility at the most senior levels of the organization.
- Opportunity to develop deep expertise across leveraged lending, portfolio management, and risk governance within a global financial institution.
- Exposure to venture lending for pre-IPO companies, providing engagement with high-growth, innovation-led businesses and significant senior leadership attention.
- A collaborative, performance-driven environment where credit excellence, accountability, and sound judgment are recognized and rewarded.
- Leadership opportunity to shape and mentor the next generation of credit professionals across New York and global partner locations.
- Hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, supporting both team collaboration and individual flexibility.
- Access to Citi's global network, resources, and career development opportunities across one of the world's leading financial institutions.

Apply now to take senior ownership of complex credit decisions and help lead Citi's leveraged finance underwriting practice at the highest level.

jobs.title: Leveraged Finance Senior Underwriter / Director
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Job Description
The Leveraged Finance Underwriting team (“LFU”) is seeking a Director to join the North America team. The Director is an experienced Senior Underwriter level professional who will work with the team’s Underwriters to lead a best-in-class Leveraged Lending In-Business Credit organization with the primary goal of materially enhancing Citi’s end-to-end Leveraged Lending credit management process.

LFU Directors are actively involved in Citi’s credit approval and origination process for leveraged finance transactions, as well as providing ongoing oversight of Citi’s credit monitoring and portfolio management activities, supporting Citi’s Leveraged Sponsor-owned, Leveraged Corporate, Commercial and Venture Lending clients.
Our Senior Underwriters have a comprehensive understanding of a wide range of complex financial issues facing our clients and can provide the opportunity to further develop an enhanced set of core credit skills. Combined with an appreciation of the broad set of services offered by Citi, this understanding allows us to effectively deliver innovative solutions to our clients, as well as properly manage the credit exposure within global Citi’s Leveraged Lending Portfolio.

Role and Responsibilities

- Work with team of Underwriters to oversee and provide critical support and leadership across LFU’s core functions: (1) Leveraged Finance transaction origination and credit approval; (2) periodic credit monitoring; (3) portfolio management, limits and early problem recognition; (4) global leveraged lending related projects and strategic initiatives
- Collaborate with our product partners in Leverage Finance Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Corporate & Commercial Banking and Risk Management, to carry out complex leveraged deal approvals for both Sponsors and Corporates. Work as part of the deal team, coordinating the deal execution, participating in due diligence, assessing risks and seeking committee approval on behalf of clients
- Interact regularly with our product partners in Leverage Finance Capital Markets Origination and Legal counsel developing the ability to understand the deal structuring/terms and ensure they are properly documented and approved as per Citi’s Standards
- Review and analyze models used for enterprise valuation and to forecast the client's operating and financial performance and be able to articulate assumptions and analysis to Senior Business and Risk
- Evaluate and gain a strong understanding of clients' business, financial performance and key credit drivers across various industries with the objective of building credit opinions / recommendations raising issues and concerns as needed
- Supervise the LFU Mumbai team responsible to perform periodic written reviews of the clients' financial and operating performance, covenant compliance, management/relationship strategy, and competitive position within its peer group
- Help manage the LFU junior team, responsible for their credit training, mentoring and professional growth throughout their tenure in the group
- Analyze underlying business rationale/strategy for deals that are conducted through creating both Business and portfolio reviews for Senior Management on the global risks for the portfolio as well as to highlight key trends in the market
- Thought leader to help develop and execute on a robust governance framework for ICM’s credit underwriting end-to-end processes
- Lead responses and defend credits during Global Credit Reviews, Internal Audits, and Regulatory Reviews
- Remain current on relevant Leveraged Lending market trends

Qualifications

- Master’s in Finance / MBA with 12+ years of Non-Investment credit or related Leveraged Finance experience
- Leveraged Finance underwriting or origination experience
- Team player with strong work ethic who also works well with others
- Proven ability to lead and execute multi-team / multi-region projects
- Strong writing, analytical, communication, and presentation skills
- Experience in coaching and mentoring junior bankers/underwriters
- Ability to take on demanding responsibilities, work under pressure, demonstrate initiative, and work independently while juggling multiple tasks at one time

jobs.title: Transaction Banking – Head of Asia South Core Trade Franchise (Documentary Trade) (Director)
jobs.description:
Team/Role Overview
Are you looking for a career move that will put you at the heart of a global financial institution? Then bring your expertise in trade finance, product management, client engagement, strategic execution, and leadership to Citi's Core Trade business.

By joining Citi, you will become part of a global organization whose mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress.
The Core Trade organization is responsible for a broad suite of documentary trade products, including Letters of Credit, Standby Letters of Credit, Guarantees and Documentary Collections.

The Head of Asia South Core Trade Franchise will be responsible for driving the growth, commercialization, product stewardship, and strategic development of the Core Trade business across the Asia South cluster. The role will lead a team of product professionals and work closely with Sales, Banking, Operations, Risk, Technology, and functional partners to deliver market-leading trade solutions, drive revenue growth and enhance client experience.

This role reports to the Global Head of Core Trade Network and Productivity and is a key member of the regional Trade & Working Capital Solutions leadership team.

Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Business Management
- Accountable for overall franchise performance including revenues, wallet growth, client penetration, market share expansion and return on allocated resources across the Asia South cluster
- Lead and develop the Asia South Core Trade team, providing strategic direction, people leadership and business oversight.
- Define and execute the Core Trade strategy across the cluster, aligned with global product priorities and regional growth opportunities.
- Drive revenue growth, portfolio expansion and market share gains across key client segments and trade corridors.
- Identify emerging market opportunities and develop targeted growth initiatives to strengthen Citi's competitive position.
- Partner with cluster, country, and global stakeholders to ensure alignment on strategic priorities and execution.
- Champion simplification, digitization, and scalable operating models to improve client experience and business efficiency.
- Drive performance management across the cluster with clear accountability for revenue, productivity, pipeline conversion and client outcomes.

Product Commercialization & Market Growth
- Own the commercialization and market development of Core Trade products across Asia South.
- Drive pipeline origination, deal execution and portfolio growth through close partnership with Sales, Bankers and Relationship Managers.
- Act as the senior product advisor for complex client opportunities, large transactions and strategic mandates.
- Promote innovative trade solutions and support the development of new products, structures and trade corridors.
- Coordinate product lifecycle activities in partnership with global product management teams.
- Monitor market trends, client needs and competitor developments to identify opportunities for growth and differentiation.
- Lead strategic client engagement efforts to deepen relationships and increase product penetration.

Stakeholder Management & Partnerships
- Build strong partnerships across Sales, Banking, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Technology and Finance.
- Collaborate with regional and global product leaders to share best practices and drive consistent execution.
- Influence senior stakeholders across the franchise to advance strategic initiatives and deliver business outcomes.
- Represent Citi's Core Trade business in key internal and external forums, including client meetings, industry events and regulatory discussions where appropriate.
- Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability and client-centricity across the organization.

Risk Management & Governance
- Ensure strong product governance and adherence to applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
- Drive disciplined risk management while balancing client needs and commercial objectives.
- Partner closely with Risk, ICRM and Business Risk teams to manage portfolio quality and support sustainable growth.
- Promote a strong control environment and ensure transparency in the escalation and management of issues.
- Maintain oversight of product governance, regulatory developments, and policy implementation across the cluster.

Talent Development
- Attract, develop, and retain high-performing product talent.
- Create a culture focused on client impact, execution excellence, and continuous improvement.
- Coach and mentor team members, fostering leadership capability and succession planning.
- Support employee development through meaningful career opportunities and targeted learning initiatives.

Qualifications
Experience
- 15+ years of relevant experience within Trade Finance, Transaction Banking, Product Management or related disciplines.
- Extensive experience in documentary trade products including Letters of Credit, Guarantees, Standby Letters of Credit and Collections.
- Proven track record of driving product growth, commercialization and revenue generation across multiple markets.
- Significant leadership experience managing teams within a complex, matrixed organization.
- Demonstrated success working across regional or global businesses and managing diverse stakeholder groups.
- Experience covering large geographic regions and multiple regulatory environments.

Skills & Knowledge
- Deep expertise in documentary trade products and trade finance structures.
- Strong commercial orientation with demonstrated ability to drive revenue growth and client acquisition.
- Excellent strategic thinking, analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
- Strong influencing and stakeholder management skills with the ability to lead across organizational boundaries.
- Outstanding communication and presentation skills with experience engaging senior executives and clients.
- Strong understanding of risk, controls, governance, and regulatory requirements.
- Proven ability to execute effectively in complex and rapidly changing environments.
- Experience leading transformation, digitization and process simplification initiatives is highly desirable.

Education
- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
- Master's Degree is "Good to Have".

jobs.title: Services (Transaction Banking) Head – Pakistan, Director
jobs.description:
This is a compelling opportunity to lead Citi's Services (Transaction Banking) business in Pakistan — one of the most strategically significant and complex emerging markets within the Middle East & Pakistan (MEP) cluster — at the Director (C15) level. As a senior member of both the MEP Services subcluster leadership team and the Citi Country Management team for Pakistan, you will shape and execute a market-level strategy that drives revenue growth, deepens client relationships, and reinforces Citi's position as the premier global transaction banking partner in the country

Citi Services is a world-leading provider of cash management, trade services and custody products to Financial Institutions, Public Sector, Corporate and Commercial clients across more than 100 countries. Our global network is uniquely positioned to serve clients with local and cross-border needs through integrated reporting, digital solutions and deep institutional expertise

As Services Head for Pakistan, you will serve as the senior strategic leader and primary client engagement head for the Services business — with direct accountability over revenue outcomes, talent strategy, regulatory relationships, and the digital innovation agenda. Pakistan presents a distinctive opportunity: a large, fast-evolving banking landscape undergoing significant digital transformation, with a young population, expanding financial inclusion agenda, and growing demand for sophisticated transaction banking solutions. This is a platform for leaders who aspire to broader MEA or global leadership roles within Citi

Key Responsibilities
Responsibilities are organized across six core leadership pillars:
1. Strategic Leadership
● Define and execute short- and long-term Services strategy for Pakistan, aligned to MEP cluster and global objectives
● Expand market and client wallet share; broaden the client solutions portfolio across all segments including Financial Institutions, Public Sector, Corporate and Commercial clients
● Navigate a complex matrix environment, aligning stakeholders across competing priorities at country, cluster and global levels
● Drive the digital transformation and innovation agenda through product partners in response to Pakistan's evolving market dynamics, regulatory priorities and fintech disruption
● Develop strategic responses to macroeconomic shifts — including currency, inflation and sovereign risk factors specific to the Pakistan market — and evolving risk profiles
● Ensure the overall business strategy is clearly articulated to all key stakeholders including the CCO, Banking, Services teams, Operations, Technology and second- and third-line partners

2. Business & Revenue Growth
● Deliver on Revenue, EBIT, Expenses and all agreed financial KPIs for Pakistan
● Lead client acquisition, retention and wallet-share expansion strategy across all Services business lines
● Oversee the end-to-end Services business in Pakistan, including sales, product, operations and technology teams
● Work closely with the Services Operations Head to advance the business agenda and drive operational efficiency
● Identify, develop and prioritize technology business cases, obtaining cluster and global buy-in
● Compete effectively against traditional domestic and global banks and non-bank transactional service providers through superior client propositions and innovative solutions
● Capitalize on Pakistan's expanding financial inclusion and digitization agenda to grow Citi's footprint in priority segments

3. Client Engagement
● Serve as the primary client engagement head for all Services business in Pakistan
● Generate active, senior-level client interactions and build strategic, long-term client relationships across the Financial Institutions, Public Sector, Corporate and Commercial segments
● Deploy optimal service solutions tailored to client needs across all segments and business lines
● Provide leadership to the Pakistan Services team in advancing advice, insights and solutions to the client base
● Drive execution of client experience initiatives aligned to Citi's "Be the Best for our Clients" vision
● Partner with Banking and Markets colleagues to deliver a balanced, country-wide client strategy

4. Risk & Governance
● Maintain full responsibility for product, operational, conduct and compliance risk management relevant to Services Pakistan.
● Ensure regulatory and statutory compliance with the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) and all applicable local and international regulatory requirements at all times; foster a strong controls culture within the team
● Actively participate in Internal Audit and External (Regulatory) audit processes, ensuring timely deliverables and representation of risk mitigants for optimum results
● Engage in Legal Vehicle Governance processes and proactively escalate potential franchise-level issues
● Develop deep Balance Sheet expertise; act as a strong partner in negotiating with Treasury and Markets, balancing Services priorities with franchise-wide considerations
● Participate actively in Country governance forums, ensuring decision-making inclusion across all critical elements that impact the Pakistan franchise

5. Stakeholder & External Engagement
● Articulate Services business strategy clearly to the Pakistan CCO, Banking, Operations, Technology and all control partners
● Build productive, trust-based working relationships with the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP), clearing houses, payment service providers and other regulatory bodies, supervisors and policy makers relevant to the Services business
● Represent Citi externally at industry associations, forums, congresses, conferences and committees within Pakistan and the broader region
● Drive Regulatory Advocacy to achieve business objectives and support Citi's franchise positioning in the market
● Maintain strong internal alignment across MEP subcluster leadership, global Services heads, and the Pakistan Country Management team

6. People & Culture
● Build and lead a high-performing, diverse and inclusive Services team in Pakistan
● Drive an effective talent strategy, ensuring appropriately skilled and experienced individuals are in critical roles
● Develop the next generation of Services leadership within the Pakistan organization
● Promote an ethical, inclusive culture embedded in Citi's highest standards of conduct
● Engage employees meaningfully in the broader business strategy and organizational direction
● Foster a strong control environment and risk-aware culture at all levels of the Pakistan team

What We're Looking For
Essential Requirements
Candidates must be able to demonstrate the following:
● 15+ years of work experience in the financial services industry, including 10+ years at a senior managerial level
● Deep transaction banking expertise — cash management, trade services and/or custody products
● Proven success leading country-level or cluster-level business strategy and delivering financial results (Revenue, EBIT, P&L)

jobs.title: Business Risk Officer - Vice President
jobs.description:
Citi Global Markets provides world-class solutions and an unmatched global presence. Citi Global Markets serve corporates, institutional investors and governments from trading floors in almost 80 countries. The strength of our underwriting, sales and trading and distribution capabilities span asset classes (Commodities, Equities, Rates, Spread Products) and currencies, providing an unmatched ability to meet the needs of our clients.

The 1st Line of Defence (1LOD) Markets Controls Testing team is part of Central Control Organisation supporting the Markets business, and is responsible for execution of a comprehensive, risk-based programme of control testing covering all Markets businesses globally. The primary mission of the 1LOD Markets Controls Testing team is to support Management in its continuous monitoring of its control framework and residual risk profiles, thereby supporting responsible provision of financial services to clients and effective risk management for the firm.

This position reports to the Global Markets Control Testing Programme Head, within the Central Testing Utility. The Global Markets Control Testing Programme Head leads and directs a team of approximately 100 controls testing professionals responsible for supporting the above responsibilities, with breadth and depth on control testing planning and execution.

Responsibilities:

This role is to plan, execute and report the results of control testing covering Markets Trading and Sales businesses.

Key responsibilities of the role are:
- Executing and reporting results of control testing
- Supervising and coaching junior team members in execution of control testing
- Monitoring execution of parts of the testing programme to agreed timelines, escalating and resolving obstacles to delivery
- Maintaining high standards and best practice for execution of testing activities
- Providing challenge to stakeholders on the design and effectiveness of controls
- Supporting stakeholders in determining necessary control remediation identified through the testing programme
- Maintaining strong stakeholder relationships across Front Office, Markets Conduct Risk, Compliance and Operational Risk
- Presenting impactful summary outputs from the testing programme to stakeholders
- Providing Markets controls subject matter expertise to stakeholders across all three lines of defence

Knowledge, Experience & Skills:
- Relevant experience in Front Office controls testing, internal audit, external audit, independent control reviews, or similar disciplines
- Understanding of Markets business activities and associated regulations
- Knowledge of Markets Operational and Compliance risks, and related controls, associated with trading and sales activities
- Strong understanding of control design assessment and effectiveness testing techniques and practices
- Experience of coaching and developing team members
- Experience of overseeing a team to deliver rigor and attention to detail in execution
- Experience of developing and maintaining effective senior stakeholder relationships
- Track record of providing constructive, effective challenge to Senior Stakeholders on risk management matters

Education:
- Bachelor / university education preferred, but appropriate industry experience & exceptional delivery track record is as important.

jobs.description:
The Relationship Associate will be responsible for supporting the Public Sector Banking team and its clients with various types of financial transactions across Citi’s Banking, Markets, and Services businesses. The Relationship Associate will play an important intermediary role between clients and various groups within Citi and must act as a client advocate while holding partners accountable to deliver with high standards. The goal of this position is to deliver the best client experience while identifying cross-sell opportunities and deepening client relationships.  The Relationship Associate will be guided by the Public Sector Banking Parent Account Managers (PAMs) and the Public Sector Banking Leadership team.

Description of Role & Responsibilities:
- Deliver the highest degree of client satisfaction through day-to-day execution and client interactions guided by the Parent Account Managers (PAMs)
- Identify cross-sell opportunities across Banking, Markets, and Services leveraging all client interactions and converting challenges to opportunities
- Develop deep knowledge of the client and their finance/banking operations to advocate for their needs within the Citi network and contribute to the sales process and sales deal teams
- Build working relationships with all internal, front, middle and back-office stakeholders and external stakeholders to ensure timely delivery, support, and problem resolution for client needs
- Lead timely escalations with internal stakeholders to break down silos and remove barriers to execution
- Become expert in navigating Citi processes and systems and apply a Public Sector lens to ensure the unique needs of our sector are met
- Master Opus, CRM, and all relevant pipeline systems to enter and manage opportunities and deals in the relevant systems
- Monitor and track pipeline to assist Parent Account Managers (PAMs) with overall sales process
- Contribute to the sales process, proposals, content for client meetings, and RFP responses
- Ensure strong governance on mapping/marketing hierarchies to ensure revenues earned from all products are reflected accurately
- Assist Bankers with the preparation of account plans, relationship reviews and briefings
- Facilitate credit originations, credit allocation, approvals, documentation, bookings, fee collections and renewals across various contracts, as well as credit allocation from Parent Account Managers (PAMs) and Credit Risk Management
- Perform financial and operational investigations, including cash management and trade services, credit, foreign exchange - ensuring timely resolution and client satisfaction
- Work with relevant colleagues to perform various due diligence activities including onboarding, Know Your Client (KYC) requirements, including timely origination, monitoring, renewals and completion across all product and hierarchy/marketing levels
- Serve as main point of contact for Citi's cross-functional units such as KYC-AML and Credit Operations to ensure compliance with regulatory and credit-related legal requirements
- Appropriately assess risk, demonstrate consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citi, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Skills & Competencies:
- Passion for client service, selling, and dedication to delivering the best results on every project
- Consistently demonstrate strong execution, follow-up, and organizational skills
- Clear and concise written and verbal communication
- Proven planning, negotiation and analytical skills
- Strong aptitude for problem-solving, intellectual curiosity, confidence/judgment in challenging situations
- Interest in Public Sector and geopolitics, with proficiency in macroeconomic, regulatory and industry trends shaping the needs of public sector clients
- Credit skills/experience (i.e., financial accounting, loan structuring, etc.) preferred
- Comprehensive knowledge of treasury models and philosophies (funding model, cash management strategy, decision making, wallet sharing, etc.)
- Understanding of Banking, Markets, and Services products
- Comprehensive knowledge of support, credit, and legal documentation requirements (e.g. Letters of Comfort, parent guarantees, LC's, ISDA/CSA, Short Term Loan agreements, Cards Agreements, etc.)

- Master's degree preferred

jobs.title: KYC Operations Analyst 1, Citi Commercial Bank (UAE Nationals Only)
jobs.description:
The KYC Operation is an AML/KYC support and control function responsible for the due diligence, approval of the KYC Record and associated documentation in partnership with relationship Management and Compliance.
The candidate will have a direct responsibility to conduct research for company information from both internal and external sources, documenting specifics required to satisfy regulations. There are differing requirements depending on where the account is being opened. There is a constant need for KYC Record review as there are periodic renewals of the required due diligence carried out based on the risk of the client.
The BSU owns the end-to-end KYC process from creation/renewal to approval of the KYC Record and supporting local country appendices

Key Responsibilities:
- Create the KYC Record in the KYC system sourcing information from internal and external sources by the agreed deadline
- Proactively interact with relationship management teams and compliance to update system with information until final approval of KYC Record
- Review information from internal and external sources for company news (Firm website, Regulatory websites, Company website, Dun & Bradstreet, Google etc.)
- Validate the information within the KYC Record and CIP document to ensure completeness and accurate (Company/Entity Formation documents, Ownership, Management, etc.)
- Complete KYC Record incorporating local regulatory requirements / Global BSU Standards and policies
- Take responsibility for KYC Record and associated documentation completion from initiation to approval
- Maintain BSU tool current and be able to demonstrate work carried out
- Report workflow progress to supervisor
- Ensure KYC workflow tool is kept up to date, ensuring all mandatory fields, status and commentary reflect an accurate representation of the status at all times
- Meet agreed daily targets for KYC Record review and completion within agreed Service Level Agreement timeframes
- Update workflow database regularly throughout the day
- Highlight any discrepancies to Senior Case Managers, Control Team and Section Managers
- Escalate any negative news and high-risk cases to RM/PAM/AML Compliance department
- Assist in departmental projects as required
- Lead the remediation activity if any
- Assist in departmental projects as required
- Act as SME within the team and support new joiners
- Manage makers team in absence of TL

Additional Job Description
- Communication / Reporting
- Manage upward communication – Huddle updates, escalations, issues/ concerns etc.
- Track and report time log (CMs and Case Researcher) on a daily basis
- Monitor operational metrics required for management level reporting
- Accurate time tracking in the PTS system

Knowledge/Experience:
- 1 – 2 years’ experience in banking, finance, or law
- Experience in control/risk or Compliance (AML/KYC) function (an advantage)
- Knowledge and experience of the technologies and processes used in Citi (an advantage)
- Knowledge of European Union regulatory KYC/AML requirements
- Flexible enough to work as per Business timings.
- ACAMS certified (an advantage)

Qualifications:
- University degree preferably in Business/Finance, Math, Economics, Engineering, Optimization, or Law

Skills:

jobs.title: CEP Markets Governance Analyst (Assistant Vice President))
jobs.description:
This 10 month fixed term contract role is focused on contributing to and executing internal strategies, policies and procedures, processes, and programs to support meeting the Markets business objectives and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations, while delivering an efficient, successful Markets Operations Operating Model in CEP.

The Citibank Europe Plc (CEP) Markets Operations Team, based in Dublin, manages all governance and oversight for CEP Markets products. The role of the team in Dublin is to monitor and report to key stakeholders, work with service providers to ensure market products are managed in an efficient manner and closely liaise   with various Operations and Technology (O&T) partners and CEP Markets Head and Business Unit Management (BUM).

What you'll do
- Monitoring KRIs (Key Risk Indicators) to ensure they remain within agreed thresholds/ appetite and reporting status to key stakeholders
- Managing relationships with service providers through regular communication and planned reviews of KRIs and documentation
- Monthly KRI report preparation (SMR) and presentation at various governance (PCF49)
- Presence at regional controls calls, risk fora and regulatory fora updates
- New Product Approvals for CEP Operations
- Permitted Product List (PPL) Review for CEP Operations
- Quarterly Managers Control Assessment (MCA) review
- Escalation of issues to CEP senior management
- FMI reporting, SREP reporting and CSDR penalty reporting

What we'll need from you:
- BS/BA degree or equivalent combination of education/experience
- Experience of managing within a highly regulated environment.
- Knowledge of regulations that impact CEP such as EMIR, CSDR, SFTR and MiFID
- Knowledge and an understanding of the EBA guidelines relating to outsourcing
- Knowledge of Market Operations processes and Market products.
- Working knowledge of FX, Derivatives, Repo, Futures and OTC Cleared products advantageous
- Self-driven, empathetic to clients’ needs, good problem solver, results oriented
- Ability to establish and build trust with professionals and clients alike, throughout the business as a leader, advisor and business partner to the organization with a clear client orientation.
- Strong awareness of both external and internal best practice perspectives, maintaining a balanced and fresh view-point.
- Ability to conceptualize aspects of the organization’s model and its future development.
- Experience delivering strategic change programs spanning multiple years in a fast paced, large global financial services firm, ideally in an operations organization
- Energetic, flexible, collaborative, and proactive; a leader who can positively and productively add product impact to both strategic and tactical technology
- Ability to provide clear and timely analysis of data. Ability to draw on both internal and external sources of information
- Strong organizational abilities & analytical skills

What we can offer you
By joining Citi Dublin, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed) and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits that support you (and your family) to be well, live well and save well. Discover more here.

Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self every day.  We want the best talent around the world to be energised to join us, motivated to stay, and empowered to thrive.

Sounds like Citi has everything you need? Then apply to discover the true extent of your capabilities.

jobs.title: Banking - Commercial Banking - Natural Resources & Energy,  Summer Analyst, Houston - US, 2027
jobs.description:
You ’ re the brains behind our work.
Citi’s Commercial Bank (“CCB”) is looking for Summer Analysts to join the Natural Resources team in Houston. This team covers clients in the Oil & Gas (Upstream and Midstream), Energy Transition, and Power and Utilities sectors. Our Commercial Banking division works with businesses with annual sales ranging from $10 million to more than $3 billion. Our Commercial Banking Team works to find ways for our clients to maximize their growth while taking full advantage of Citi’s banking products. That means knowing all about our deposit and lending, as well as our cash management, trade, FX (foreign exchange) and capital markets solutions. The Summer Analyst Program strives to bring in the best and brightest talent and support them as they develop into the next generation of commercial banking leaders globally.
Your time here will look something like this...
The 10-week Summer Analyst Program starts in June and begins with in-depth training. People learn differently, so we combine formal training with a complete hands-on experience to help you quickly ramp up and adapt to your role and the culture at Citi. There will be ongoing sales, credit, product, technology, and professional skills training throughout the program along with a robust junior and senior mentorship structure to help you develop professionally.
By the conclusion of the Program, you can expect to have thorough experience with and a strong understanding of:
- The CCB target market, value proposition, and client coverage model
- How bankers interact with clients and identify their needs
- The various credit product types and how these solutions best fit client needs
- The commercial loan underwriting process, including loan structuring and documentation
- The end-to-end credit process including new origination of credit and the monitoring of a credit portfolio
- Engaging with clients, prospects, and centers of influence
- Citi credit and regulatory policies and procedures

We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.
You will join a Coverage team for the duration of the Program, working directly with Relationship Managers on a portfolio of clients and interfacing with teams across the firm. The role of Coverage team members is to serve as a thought partner to our clients, working closely with them to deliver the full breadth of Citi’s solutions to help them fund their operations and expand both locally and overseas.

Analysts play a critical role in meeting the needs of our clients and prospects, including:
- Conducting company research and industry analysis
- Analyzing financial data and performing financial modeling focused on company valuations, discounted cash flow analysis, and pro-forma analyses
- Supporting the commercial lending process, which includes secured and unsecured revolving lines of credit, term loans, syndicated loans, leveraged loans, cross-border loans approved locally and extended overseas through the CCB’s global network of 26 countries
- Taking ownership of the client experience, including partnering with Bankers and Product teams to determine which products to leverage in order to help clients achieve their goals
- Playing a role in deal management and client presentation preparation, including creating business development presentations, pitch books, prospect memos, and other client-related decks
- Interacting with partners across the firm, including product, credit risk, in-business controls, legal, marketing, operations, risk, compliance, and technology teams

We want to hear from you if:
- You are a dynamic individual who is passionate about partnering with stakeholders to achieve goals
- You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- You are majoring in Finance or Accounting, or have experience in Financial Services through clubs or internships
- You are on track to graduate with a bachelor’s degree in winter 2027 or spring 2028
- You have obtained a preferred GPA of 3.5 or above
- You are a proficient user of MS Word, Access, Excel, and PowerPoint
- You will not require sponsorship for U.S. Work Authorization now or anytime in the future

Annual Salary $105,000

- Partner with Relationship Management and Compliance teams to update system information from initiation to approval of KYC record and report workflow progress to supervisor
- Validate the information within KYC records and Customer Identification Program (CIP) documents to ensure completion and accuracy
- Ensure KYC records incorporate local regulatory requirements / Global Business Support Unit (BSU) Standards
- Maintain BSU tool

- 4 -6 Years relevant experience in KYC.

- Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience

The overall objective of this role is to assist in the development and management of a dedicated internal KYC (Know Your Client) program at Citi.

Responsibilities:
- Partner with Relationship Management and Compliance teams to assist with the preparation, development, due diligence and approval of the electronic Know Your Client (KYC) record and supporting appendices
- Create and maintain KYC records by obtaining information from internal and external sources (firm website, regulatory websites, etc.)
- Partner with Relationship Management and Compliance teams to update system information from initiation to approval of KYC record and report workflow progress to supervisor
- Validate the information within KYC records and Customer Identification Program (CIP) documents to ensure completion and accuracy
- Ensure KYC records incorporate local regulatory requirements / Global Business Support Unit (BSU) Standards
- Maintain BSU tool
- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

- Previous relevant experience preferred

Education:

- Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience

✅ Licenciatura Económico-Administrativa concluida (Carta Pasante con historial académico al 100% o Título y Cédula).

Atención y contacto telefónico con clientes.
Apertura de cuentas bancarias.
Procesos KYC.
Validación documental.

Artículo 115 de la Ley de Instituciones de Crédito.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst Future Opportunities Campaign
jobs.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at the world’s most global bank?

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a family of more than 200,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career and make a positive impact on society.
Citi Finance is continuously looking for talented career starters to join our steadily growing team in Budapest. Take this unique opportunity to start your career in investment banking by joining our Finance team in one of the following business areas:
- Regulatory Reporting : The Regulatory Reporting Centre in Budapest is a key part of Citi’s Finance function. It is a pioneering centre on a global scale where regulatory reporting professionals work together in a central location, to ensure consistent quality of local regulatory reporting. Our teams create complex reports that detail prime aspects of the bank’s financials for the Central Banks and other regulators.

- Product Control : Product Control, the largest department in Finance, is primarily responsible for controlling daily profit and loss reporting, price verification and trading activity for the Institutional Clients Group (ICG). We work closely across functions on a daily basis (including the Trading desks, Risk Management, Operations and other areas of Finance) and develop a deep understanding of the products traded, along with the associated market risks and accounting complexities.

- Valuation Control : The Valuation Control Group (VCG) is an independent team of subject matter experts. VCG’s primary responsibility is to reasonably ensure that risk portfolios are fairly valued in accordance with applicable standards and regulatory requirements. In doing so, the team works closely with its stakeholders, including senior management, business heads, product control, market risk, regulators, and both internal and external audit.

- Treasury : Corporate Treasury’s main duty is to oversee and manage the bank balance in order to have a proper governance that complies with the entities business and the regulation. This scope covers wide topics such as Funding, Transfer Pricing, Capital and Liquidity risk monitoring. We are in close contact with the businesses involved in the operational activities, for example the Trading desks, Credit departments, and Branches.

What we’ll need from you:
- Recent graduate or junior Finance professional with 0-3 years of work experience
- Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Actuarial Science or similar majors is an advantage but not a must - we are a development-focused organization looking look for capable colleagues and help them grow to excellence in their fields
- Good command of English
- Confident analytical and communication skills
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills - training will be provided on other in-house and industry standard systems used in these positions

By joining Citi Hungary, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive compensation package and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits that support you (and your family) to be well, live well and save well:
- Cafeteria Program
- Home Office Allowance (for colleagues working in hybrid work models)
- Paid Parental Leave Program (maternity and paternity leave)
- Private Medical Care Program and onsite medical rooms at our offices
- Pension Plan Contribution to voluntary pension fund
- Group Life Insurance
- Employee Assistance Program
- Access to a wide variety of learning and development programs, online course libraries and upskilling platforms, such as Udemy and Degreed
- Flexible work arrangements to support you in managing work - life balance
- Career progression opportunities across geographies and business lines
- Socially active employee communities with diverse networking opportunities

Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay, and empowered to thrive.

Sounds like Citi has everything you need? Then apply to discover the true extent of your capabilities.

Apply to join the world’s most global bank and discover the true extent of your capabilities!

As a lean, entrepreneurial team within Citi’s global Investment Banking and Markets platform, professionals are given early responsibility, direct client exposure and the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to both transaction execution and the continued growth of the business.

This role offers significant client exposure, meaningful transaction responsibility and the opportunity to work alongside senior decision-makers at many of the world’s leading alternative asset managers.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the origination and execution of continuation vehicles, GP-led secondary transactions, NAV financings, preferred equity investments and other strategic capital solutions.
- Build sophisticated financial models, valuation analyses and transaction structures at both the portfolio company and fund level.
- Develop client presentations, strategic analyses, marketing materials and investment committee documentation.
- Conduct financial, commercial and structural due diligence across complex private markets transactions.
- Coordinate execution processes with clients, legal counsel, accounting firms, financing providers and other advisors.
- Support investor marketing efforts, including preparation of marketing materials, management presentations, investor due diligence and transaction execution.
- Work closely with Sponsor Coverage, Investment Banking, Capital Markets, Financing and other product partners across Citi to deliver integrated client solutions.
- Monitor market developments across GP-led secondaries, NAV financing, private capital formation and broader strategic capital solutions.
- Contribute to internal market intelligence, analytical tools, thought leadership and business development initiatives supporting the continued expansion of the Advisory platform.

Qualifications
- 2–5 years of experience in investment banking, secondaries advisory, private equity, infrastructure investing, private credit, valuation advisory or another relevant financial advisory role.
- Strong financial modeling, valuation and analytical skills.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication abilities.
- Ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
- Strong attention to detail, sound judgment and excellent project management skills.
- Demonstrated interest in private markets, alternative asset management and strategic advisory.

Preferred Experience
Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:
- GP-led secondary transactions.
- Continuation vehicles.

- Preferred equity.
- Private equity.

jobs.title: KYC Operations Analyst 2(Quality Checker)
jobs.description:
Job Description
The KYC Operations Senior Analyst is an intermediate-level professional responsible for executing Anti-Money Laundering (AML) monitoring, governance, and regulatory reporting activities. This role is integral to the development and management of Citi's internal Know Your Client (KYC) program. The ideal candidate will apply in-depth disciplinary knowledge to contribute to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and workflow. Operating with a high degree of independence, this individual will ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies, safeguarding the firm's reputation and assets.

- Independently reviews quality, validates, verifies, and signs off on the files completed by the Maker/Checker to ensure full accuracy, compliance, and procedural alignment before final approval and system submission.
- Act as a critical review point for KYC records and submissions from junior analysts across global hubs, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to established procedures.
- Conduct and analyze complex Enhanced Due Diligence, client name screening dispositions, and sanctions reviews for high-risk client profiles.
- Proactively identify, analyze, and escalate potential money laundering risks, suspicious activities, and compliance deficiencies to senior management with transparency.
- Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on KYC matters, providing guidance and support to senior stakeholders, private bankers, and other team members.
- Liaise effectively with internal and external stakeholders to manage exceptions, resolve complex issues, and facilitate a seamless and efficient onboarding experience.
