jobs.title: シンジケートローンエージェンシー・融資事務担当（Loan Agency & Operations Analyst）
jobs.description:
【このポジションについて / About this role】

Citi Japan のオペレーション部門において、ローン・エージェンシー業務を中心に携わりながら、ローン・オペレーション業務（取引計上・仕訳・元帳管理など）にもクロスファンクショナルで関与できる、希少性の高いポジションです。シンジケートローンのエージェント業務をメインとしつつ、ローン・オペレーション両方に携われるハイブリッドな人材を求めています。AIを活用した業務効率化にも積極的に取り組める方を歓迎します。
This is a rare dual-scope opportunity within Citi Japan's Operations function — you will take ownership of syndicated loan agency operations while also contributing directly to Loan Operations across deal booking, journal entry, and general ledger management. If you are motivated to build specialist expertise across both functions and are open to working with modern, AI-assisted tools, this role offers meaningful cross-functional exposure from day one.

Responsibilities
【主な業務内容 / Key responsibilities】
- シンジケートローンのエージェント業務をエンドツーエンドで担当します — ドローダウン処理、ロールオーバー管理、返済、手数料決済、案件クローズまでの全ライフサイクルを管理します。(Deliver end-to-end syndicated loan agency operations across the full deal lifecycle, including drawdown processing, rollover management, repayment, fee settlement, and deal closure.)

- シンジケート参加行への通知配布、金利リセット、貸出割当、手数料配分などのエージェント銀行業務を正確に調整・実行します。(Coordinate agent bank functions with precision, including the distribution of notices, interest rate resets, lender allocations, and fee distributions to syndicate members.)

- リレーションシップマネージャー、クレジット、法務、ファイナンス等の社内関係者、および外部の貸付人・借入人との間で、ローン・エージェンシー・チームの主要な業務窓口を担います。(Act as the primary operational contact between the Loan Agency team, internal stakeholders, and external lenders and borrowers throughout the syndication lifecycle.)

- LoanIQを含む社内システムへのディール計上、現金取引の記録、ポジション更新など、ローン・オペレーションチームの日常的な取引処理を担当します。(Process deal bookings, cash transactions, and position updates within loan management systems including LoanIQ, as part of the Loan Operations supporting scope.)

- 融資案件にわたる仕訳（JE）および元帳（GL）エントリーを正確に入力・管理します。(Maintain journal entries and general ledger entries across multi-currency and multi-tranche loan structures with accuracy.)

- ポジション照合、現金照合、ノストロ照合を実施し、差異を特定・解消することでローン記録の正確性を維持します。(Conduct position, cash, and nostro reconciliations, identifying and resolving breaks to maintain accurate loan records.)

- オペレーションおよびテクノロジーチームと連携し、システム改善プロジェクトへ参画します — ユーザー受け入れテスト（UAT）、プロセス文書化、プラットフォームアップグレードへの変更管理を含みます。(Collaborate with operations and technology colleagues on system enhancement projects, contributing to UAT, process documentation, and platform improvement initiatives.)

- 案件のコベナンツおよびコンプライアンス要件をモニタリングし、例外や違反が発生した際には適切なガバナンス経路を通じて迅速かつ適切にエスカレーションします。(Monitor deal covenants and compliance requirements, escalating exceptions or breaches through appropriate governance channels in a timely manner.)

Required qualifications & skills
【必須要件 / Required qualifications】
- 金融機関における4年以上の実務経験があり、ローンプロセス（ディール計上、GL/JEの基本原則、ローン照合、現金決済）に関する実務知識を有していること。(More than 4 years of experience at a financial institution, with working knowledge of loan processes including deal booking, general ledger and journal entry principles, reconciliation practices, and cash settlement.)

- ローン文書（信用契約書、ファシリティレター、エージェント銀行通知など）の管理・準備・レビューを担当できること。(Ability to manage, prepare, and review loan documentation including credit agreements, facility letters, and agent bank notices within a syndicated loan context.)

- 業務上のリスクや問題を特定、軽減、管理、エスカレーションできること。(Demonstrated ability to identify, mitigate, manage, and escalate operational risks and issues accurately and in a timely manner.)

- 適用される法令・規制・社内ポリシーの遵守に対する高いコンプライアンス意識を有していること。(Strong awareness of and commitment to complying with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies, with a consistent track record of doing so.)

- 日本語ネイティブレベル（話す・書く・読む）— 外部取引先とのエンゲージメント、ローン文書管理、日本市場における規制対応に不可欠です。(Native-level Japanese across speaking, writing, and reading — essential for external counterparty engagement, loan documentation management, and regulatory correspondence in the Japanese market.)

- AIを活用した業務ツールや新技術に対して好奇心と積極的な姿勢を持ち、インテリジェントオートメーションやAIによる文書処理の業務導入に意欲があること。(Genuine curiosity and openness toward AI-assisted tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to explore their application in operations workflows including intelligent automation and AI-powered document processing.)

Beneficial skills & qualifications
【歓迎要件 / Beneficial qualifications】
- シンジケートローン、ローン・エージェンシー業務、またはローン・オペレーション業務における実務経験があること。(Prior exposure to syndicated lending, loan agency operations, or loan operations within a financial institution.)

- LoanIQ（Finastra LoanIQ）または同等のローン管理システムにおける実務経験（特にディール計上、サービシング、照合業務）があること。(Hands-on experience with LoanIQ or an equivalent loan management system, particularly in deal booking, servicing, or reconciliation workflows.)

- クロスボーダー案件対応やグローバル拠点とのコミュニケーションに活用できるビジネスレベルの英語力（話す・書く・読む）があること。(Business-level English proficiency across speaking, writing, and reading, to support communication with global counterparts and cross-border deal coordination.)

- システム改善活動（UATへの参加、プラットフォーム展開プロジェクトなど）への参画経験があること。(Familiarity with system enhancement activities, including participation in user acceptance testing or platform rollout projects within an operations environment.)

What we offer

Citi Japan（シティグループ証券株式会社）では、シンジケートローンのプロフェッショナルとして成長できる実践的な環境を提供しています。ローン・エージェンシーとローン・オペレーションの両方に携わることができる、市場でも稀なポジションです。At Citi Japan, you will join a performance-driven team where professional growth, operational excellence, and forward-thinking ways of working are valued. This role offers structured development within one of the world's leading financial institutions.

- 週3日オフィス勤務・週2日在宅勤務のハイブリッド勤務制度を採用しており、柔軟な働き方と対面でのチーム連携を両立できます。(A hybrid working arrangement with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, balancing flexibility with in-person team collaboration.)

- ローン・エージェンシーとローン・オペレーションという2つの業務領域に同時に関われる、市場でも稀なキャリア機会です。(Hands-on development across both Loan Agency and Loan Operations — a dual-scope role that builds breadth of expertise uncommon at this career stage.)

- AIを活用した業務ツールやシステム改善プロジェクトに積極的に参画でき、ローン・オペレーション業務のデジタル化を推進する最前線に立てます。(Exposure to AI-assisted tools and system modernization projects, placing you at the forefront of digital transformation within Loan Operations.)

- グローバルなファイナンシャルインスティテューションであるCitiのネットワークと学習・研修リソースを活用し、シンジケートローン領域での専門性を着実に高められます。(Access to learning and development resources that support your growth within the syndicated lending space and across Citi's global markets business.)

- ローン・オペレーションチーム内での明確なキャリアパスがあり、将来を見据えた人材育成に注力するチームでのポジションです。(A clear pathway for career progression within the Loan Operations team, supported by a team committed to developing future-ready operations professionals.)

シンジケートローンのスペシャリストとして、Citi Japanの日本市場における中核業務を担うポジションに応募してください。(Apply now to take ownership of a role at the heart of syndicated loan agency and operations in the Japanese market, and build a distinctive career with Citi Japan.)

jobs.title: Community Investing and Development - Program Analyst
jobs.description:
Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here.  At Citi , you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks.  We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning.  You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

Citi’s Enterprise Services and Public Affairs (ESPA) aims to enhance how our stakeholders perceive and experience Citi.  We manage our reputation by engaging with our stakeholders and delivering great spaces and services to colleagues and clients.

Description:
The Program Analyst is a key member of the Community Investing and Development (CID) team, reporting to the Director of Community Programs and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) India. The CID team advances economic opportunity through impact investing, employee volunteerism and philanthropy. CID also supports fulfilment of important regulatory responsibilities, including Section 135 of the Companies Act in India. The Program Analyst will support key activities including planning, scheduling, administration and office management, project management, travel logistics and other support activities for CID’s work across International, with a focus on India.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide administrative and operational support to the CID team, with a primary focus on supporting the Directors of CSR India and International Community Relations, including coordinating team meetings, maintaining distribution lists, facilitating organizational updates and tracking action plans and assisting with follow-up activities.
- Manage and coordinate calendars for the Director of CSR India and the Director of International Community Relations, including scheduling meetings, prioritizing requests, and tracking follow-up actions.
- Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including itineraries, agendas, briefing materials, and logistics support for the Directors.
- Prepare, submit, reconcile, and track corporate expense reports through Citi Travel & Expense systems, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies.
- Prepare, format, and maintain presentations, spreadsheets, reports, meeting materials, and other business documents to support team activities and leadership communications and follow-ups.
- Provide administrative support for employee engagement and volunteerism initiatives, assisting with coordination, communications, tracking, and execution of selected activities and campaigns.
- Support coordination of cross-regional initiatives and activities, including helping facilitate planning and execution activities such as monitoring and follow-up support.

- Support leadership participation in internal and external events and working groups, through meeting coordination, logistics management, and materials preparation.
- Manage administrative processes, including ordering supplies and processing invoices through the Procure-to-Pay system.
- Maintain shared team knowledge resources, databases, and tracking tools, including CRM entries, visibility pipeline updates and related records.

- Support ongoing efforts to improve team processes, organization, and operational effectiveness.
- Assist with data collection, reporting, tracking, and special projects to support team operations and strategic priorities.

Qualifications
- Previous administrative or office management experience preferred. Interest in or exposure to community investing, philanthropy, or corporate social responsibility is also preferred.
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook) and the ability to quickly learn new systems and leverage AI-enabled tools.
- Self-starter with strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.
- Excellent organizational, coordination, and project management skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with colleagues and external stakeholders.
- Proven ability to manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and consistently meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Makes evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information. They are expected to resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents. Must be able to exchange information in a concise and logical way as well as be sensitive to audience diversity. Impact of the job holder is restricted to own job.

- Conduct in-depth and timely due diligence reviews of IPB customers identified as 'high risk' to comply with the AML/KYC policies and procedures
- Makes evaluative judgments based on the analysis of factual KYC information provided by Relationship Manager and highlight/escalate issues to supervisor, management and/or compliance and follow up on corrective actions
- Ensure completeness of documentation required during the review (e.g., disposition of name screening results)
- Provide adequate documentation of the work performed for each case
- Perform transaction reviews (large cash and overlay reports) to determine any potential AML concerns
- Resolves problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.

jobs.description:
Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here.  At Citi , you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks.  We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning.  You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

Citi’s Independent Compliance Risk Management (ICRM) is an independent control function that provides guidance and challenge to the firm, managing compliance risk and promoting behavior that is consistent with Citi’s mission.

The AML Program Assessment (PA) team acts as the key AML contact for the Treasury & Trade Solutions businesses for Foreign Correspondent Banks (FCB) and Payment Intermediaries (PI) and is primarily responsible for ensuring the timely and effective review, management, identification and escalation (where required) of AML risk as related to our FCB& PI client’s AML Programs, controls and activity.

As part of their review, the team is responsible for ensuring that appropriate levels of due diligence and Know Your Customer (KYC) checks are conducted on FCB & PI relationships in line with relevant regulatory standards and for AML and regulatory training in regards to all FCB & PI relationships located across the relevant region and representation of AML in all relevant FCB & PI related forums. Additionally, the team undertake transaction analysis of these high-risk client accounts to confirm usage in line with client profile.

We’re currently looking for a high caliber professional to join our team as AML Program Assessment Senior Compliance Analyst, AVP (Internal Job Title: AML Risk Management Senior Analyst - C12 ) based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.  Being part of our team means that we’ll provide you with the resources to meet your unique needs, empower you to make healthy decision and manage your financial well-being to help plan for your future.  For instance:
- Citi provides programs and services for your physical and mental well-being including access to telehealth options, health advocates, confidential counseling and more. Coverage varies by country.

- Citi provides access to an array of learning and development resources to help broaden and deepen your skills and knowledge as your career progresses.

In this role, you’re expected:
- Review of the FCB & PIs AML Program controls and identification of any concerns or weaknesses that may expose Citi to an unacceptable level of AML risk

- Finalize/Review Periodic Transaction Reports, which includes identifying unusual/suspicious Red Flags, validating Negative Media, and analysing High-risk activity flows.

- Full ownership of this process from start to finish is expected, including coordination of client interactions, follow up for client responses, acquisition of required information from internal stakeholders, etc. culminating in a written assessment of client AML program, including escalations as necessary.

- Assist with ad-hoc projects to improve processes.

- Additional duties as assigned.

- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:
- Minimum 5 years relevant experience

- General and broad understanding of key AML and reputational risks, including PEPs, Sanctions, A B&C.

- Understanding of cash management products and correspondent banking.

- Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication

- Ability to work simultaneously with multiple conflicting priorities, timelines and stakeholders.

- Excellent judgment and assessment skills; proactively employs personal curiosity to identify and research parties using a risk-based approach.

- Excellent interpersonal and team-building skills.

- Self-motivated and detail oriented

- ACAMS certification is an advantage.

- Prior experience with transaction-based KYC reviews is an advantage.

- English language proficiency is a requirement and, the candidate must be able to listen, speak, read and write at an advanced level.

- Mandarin language proficiency is an advantage.

- Education : Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a family of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.
